text: いま…　その　あかしに　グリーン　バッジを　わたそう！

structure.jp: グリーン　バッジを

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The おう ending on a verb says 'I shall' or 'let's': the speaker has decided to do it. わたそう = 'I shall hand it over'

patterns.name: 〜に (as)
patterns.explanation: に here says what role the thing plays: 'as'. あかしに = 'as proof'
